title: Clearing commands name the wrong verb: settle for finding holds, 'findings' (list) for the finding wait, run-epic for cloud failures
description:
statusmodel/build.go:761-775 emits 'ticfac settle ... --release' for every run_held line whatever the reason (finding_untriaged is cleared by ticfac triage); build.go:834 names 'ticfac findings <epic>', which only lists; overview.go:228,247 and build.go:755 name 'ticfac run-epic <epic>', which for a cloud run restarts it locally in the foreground instead of 'ticfac run <epic> --cloud'. watch.go:317 prints a literal <epic-id> placeholder. Merge waits and cancelled runs name no command.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding f476264ed5a26c09d3dc15265c177fd1d50d55174e23efe1480836515d5143a2 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-xbp/attempt-32): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A2. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/f476264ed5a26c09d3dc15265c177fd1d50d55174e23efe1480836515d5143a2.json on the run branch.
notes:

The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/f476264ed5a26c09d3dc15265c177fd1d50d55174e23efe1480836515d5143a2.json on epic/2jn, and it says: no classifier prediction could be made — no classifier is configured for gating predictions — so the reporter's own claim decides: it breaks A2, and the finding is absorbed against that item.
